perf-bot: ALERT: nightly perf job 'latency-bench' increased p99 by ~28% vs baseline (run id 2026-03-16-5678). Dashboard: https://perf.redwood/run/5678

alex: saw it. looks like the small-batch path is spiking. dashboard shows a hotspot at `kv-cache-lookup` step.

maria: assigning bisect to @cheng — can you take this? if not, @sam please pick up.

cheng: taking it. grabbing the nightly artifact now. which commit range did the job run against?

alex: job pinned to origin/main. CI metadata shows SHA range 8a7f3b..9b2c1e (perf run 2026-03-16-5678).

cheng: starting binary search. I'll run the repro locally with the CI docker image. ping if you have repro steps or a quick command.

sam: I can repro locally — command I used: `./scripts/run_bench --model dd4 --batch 4 --seq 2048 --profile` outputs to `/tmp/bench.log`.

cheng: thanks, running that now. also try `--cache-size 0` to compare an uncached run (helps isolate kv-cache impact).

cheng: update: initial bisect points at PR #2437 (quantization tweak + kernel selection change). reproduces reliably on my machine. :hammer_and_wrench:

maria: nice find. can you capture a flamegraph/profile and upload? `perf record -g --` for native or `py-spy` for python. we need a visual to compare before/after.

cheng: flamegraph command I ran: `docker exec -it bench /bin/bash -c "perf record -F 99 -g -- ./bench_bin"` then `perf script | stackcollapse-perf.pl > out.folded` and `flamegraph.pl out.folded > ffg.svg`. uploaded: s3://redwood-perf/2026-03-16/5678/ffg.svg

alex: if PR #2437 is the culprit can we run a quick revert test (main without that commit)?

cheng: ran revert build (main~1 without PR #2437). p99 returned to baseline on two runs. Confirmed regression introduced by that PR. I'll open a rollback PR and annotate the perf artifacts.

sam: thanks all. follow-ups: add a targeted regression test for the kv-cache path and consider adding a micro-benchmark to the nightly gate to catch similar regressions. :memo:

maria: added an action item: infra to keep nightly artifacts for 14 days for easier bisecting. filing ticket. :clipboard:
